name: Cab Expense Report
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Invoice ID:Link/Cab Vendor Invoice:150",
    DATE(creation) AS "Date:Date:120",
    vendor AS "Vendor:Data:150",
    trip_reference AS "Cab Route:Link/Cab Route:150",
    total_amount AS "Total Expense:Currency:120"
FROM
    `tabCab Vendor Invoice`
ORDER BY
    creation DESC
